problems.title: Released scan uses an approximate input coefficient
problems.source_location: Section 4.2, Eqs.(9)–(10), PDF p.7; modem_arch.py, selective scan call; Mamba v2.0.4, selective_scan_ref
claim: The paper specifies exact zero-order hold \(\bar A=e^{\Delta A}\), \(\bar B=(e^{\Delta A}-I)A^{-1}B\). The current author release calls its pinned Mamba selective scan, whose input coefficient is \(\Delta B\).
analysis: For one state and step, take \(A=-1,B=C=1,\Delta=x_1=1,h_0=D=0\). The negative state parameter and positive step are allowed. The exact continuous equation \(\dot h=-h+1\) gives \(h(1)=1-e^{-1}\approx0.632121\), whereas the backend recurrence gives \(h_1=1\). Its transition coefficient is exponential, but its input increment uses no exponential correction.
result: The formula and linked primitive differ for the same generated coefficients. Both define legitimate discrete models; this does not refute restoration accuracy or imply that the exact-ZOH model would perform better.
repair: Document the implemented first-order coefficient \(\Delta B\), or use the exact diagonal coefficient \(\operatorname{expm1}(\Delta a)b/a\), with limit \(\Delta b\) at zero. Changing a trained model’s recurrence requires new empirical validation.
problems.impact_rationale: This is a local specification/implementation mismatch in a standard backend approximation, without demonstrated damage to the restoration results.
problems.existing_correction_status: The described correction remains a proposal; author adoption or a corresponding erratum is not established.

problems.title: Morton ordering has block locality rather than a uniform neighbor guarantee
claim: The locality motivation says nearby image pixels remain nearby in the scan.
analysis: Adjacent pixels \((2^m-1,0)\) and \((2^m,0)\) have interleaved indices \((4^m-1)/3\) and \(4^m\), so their scan gap is \((2\cdot4^m+1)/3\) despite unit spatial distance. Conversely an aligned dyadic square fixes the high interleaved bits and occupies a contiguous interval.
result: The motivation is valid as hierarchical block locality and does not require a universal adjacent-pixel bound. No permutation or inverse-scan defect is established; the empirical scan comparison is not refuted.
problems.impact_rationale: A bounded locality interpretation is sufficient for the architecture; the example only excludes an unnecessary universal interpretation.
problems.existing_correction_status: No applicable author correction was established in this inspection.

impact_rationale: Minor: the recurrence description differs from the actual standard discretization approximation, without invalidating the restoration model or its benchmark gains.
